tagline: The Lets go Brandon league newsletter · est. 2022
headline: butterygoop Is the League's First 7-0 Team, and Colt45Johnson Scores 197
dek: butterygoop wins the biggest blowout of the week, Colt45Johnson wins the semifinal rematch with a perfect lineup, triccster makes it four straight, and one free-agent tight end flips two more games.
lead:
Monday night touched five of the six games and flipped none of them.

butterygoop is 7-0, the first team in league history to get there. He beat DMsourbeer 169.92 to 101.76, the biggest margin of the week, behind Trey McBride (32.1), CeeDee Lamb (24.4) and Javonte Williams (21.5). Colt45Johnson kept pace at 6-1 with the high score of the week, 197.26 against TuanonStan in a rematch of last year's semifinal, and he left 0.60 on his bench doing it. They are the only two teams above the median in all seven weeks, and the only two the model gives a first-round bye more often than not.

managers.text: The points leader at 1,273.28 and a 51% title favorite, better than the rest of the league combined. Rhamondre Stevenson scored 22.5 on the bench and Nico Collins started for 2.6. Collins, C.J. Stroud and Chris Olave are all on bye in week 8: three pieces to replace. Saquon Barkley, on his bench, tweaked the hamstring and picked up a back issue in Monday's return. Previous best start through seven weeks: 6-1, in 2023 and 2025.
managers.next: Week 8: Jbird531. butterygoop has won four straight in the series and is an 89% favorite.

managers.text: 197.26 over TuanonStan, the team of the week and the best lineup call of the week, behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (31.3), Joe Burrow (28.88) and Jameson Williams (26.1). He has beaten Sleeper's projections by 88.6, the most in the league. His one previous 6-1 start, in 2024, ended with the title.
managers.next: Week 8: triccster, who lost their only meeting 168.62 to 134.22 last year. Colt is a 79% favorite.

managers.text: Beat Jbird531 129.00 to 111.26 behind Bo Nix (25.18), Tre Tucker (21.3) and Jonathan Taylor (19.0). Isaiah Likely started and scored 4.2. He added Jordan Watkins, who started for 8.6, and Zonovan Knight. Tyler Huntley is still his best pickup of the season, 52.6 points in three starts, and Lamar Jackson ran onto the practice field Wednesday. Likely and Mike Evans are on bye in week 8: two pieces to replace. His one previous 5-2 start, in 2024, made the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 8: Thnu, a first meeting. Wallner is a 64% favorite.

managers.text: Scored 156.34, well above the week's median, and lost by 40.92. Luther Burden (23.7), Quinshon Judkins (23.4) and Puka Nacua (21.8) led it; Denzel Boston started and scored 5.7, though he is still the top rookie in the league with 77.2. His last three weeks average 158.6, the hottest hand in the league, and he leads the Coach of the year race at 89% lineup efficiency. His two previous 4-3 starts made the playoffs, and last year's reached the final.
managers.next: Week 8: YoungBuck04, a first meeting. TuanonStan is a 71% favorite.

managers.text: Beat YoungBuck04 108.42 to 101.96, the closest game of the week, while scoring under the median. Tee Higgins (26.8), Caleb Williams (22.12) and Bijan Robinson (17.2) led it; Jahan Dotson started for 1.6 and Sam Darnold scored 14.98 on the bench. He has left 275.6 points on the bench this season, the most in the league, and has the deepest bench by projection. The model has him at 80%.
managers.next: Week 8: DMsourbeer, a first meeting and the game of the week. HillBillyWorm is at 51%.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: 0-3, then four straight wins. The latest was 149.94 to 116.68 over BROCKSTARxD, who beat him by 82.06 in this week last year. Bucky Irving (23.0), Makai Lemon (19.7) and Braelon Allen (19.4) led it; Michael Penix scored 20.42 on the bench and Derrick Henry started for 5.9. Since the week 5 trades he is 3-0, with Henry at 30.9 in three starts, Ja'Marr Chase 36.9 in two and Jaylen Waddle 20.0 in three. Erick All went on injured reserve on Tuesday with a feared torn ACL. Dalton Schultz and Tyler Shough are on bye in week 8: two pieces to replace. Last year he had two wins through seven weeks.

Lost 169.92 to 101.76 to butterygoop, the lowest score of the week, with 52.98 left on the bench, the most of the week. Mason Taylor scored 27.7 there, and Jake Ferguson started and scored 0.0 on Monday night. Zay Flowers (27.7), Amon-Ra St. Brown (24.2) and Jordan Love (17.96) led the lineup. His two previous 3-4 starts split: 2022 made the playoffs, 2023 did not. The model has him at 54%.
managers.next: Week 8: HillBillyWorm, a first meeting and the game of the week. DMsourbeer is at 49%.

managers.text: Tony Pollard scored 36.5, the best player of the week, and Thnu still lost to brettmn13 by 24.94. Tucker Kraft (16.8) and Brock Bowers (16.3) helped. Davante Adams started and scored 0.0; he is on injured reserve with a ruptured hamstring. 3-4 and 21% for the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 8: Wallner, a first meeting. Thnu is at 36%.

managers.text: Beat Thnu 135.14 to 110.20 behind Malik Willis (26.02), Ashton Jeanty (21.6) and Josh Jacobs (20.1), in Jacobs's first game of the year. Jeanty has 48.1 points in three starts since the week 5 trade. Players he brought in by trade or off the wire have started for 278.2 points, the most in the league. The model has him at 10%.
managers.next: Week 8: BROCKSTARxD, who leads the series 3-1 and won last year's meeting 144.56 to 133.68. The model has it at exactly 50-50.

managers.text: Lost the closest game of the week to HillBillyWorm, with Tyler Higbee and Justin Jefferson well under their averages. Jacoby Brissett (16.48), T.J. Hockenson (15.5) and Alvin Kamara (13.2) led the lineup, and Eli Raridon scored 16.1 on the bench. One free agent would have flipped it (see the moves). Carnell Tate is the second-best rookie in the league, at 74.3. 2-5 with the fewest points in the league, and 6% for the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 8: TuanonStan, a first meeting. YoungBuck04 is at 29%.

managers.text: Lost 149.94 to 116.68 to triccster. KC Concepcion (23.2), Christian McCaffrey (22.0) and Emanuel Wilson (18.5) led it; Brandin Cooks started for 2.3. Baker Mayfield came back and went 7 of 11 for 64 yards and a touchdown. Breece Hall was set to be limited in practice Wednesday, and Emeka Egbuka did individual drills. McCaffrey and Brock Purdy are on bye in week 8: two pieces to replace. Neither 1-6 team in league history made the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 8: brettmn13. BROCKSTARxD leads the series 3-1, and the model has it at 50-50.

managers.text: Lost 129.00 to 111.26 to Wallner. Drake Maye (28.44), Colston Loveland (23.4) and Omar Cooper (22.5) led it, and Caleb Douglas scored 21.0 on the bench. Tyler Warren, ruled out on Friday with a groin injury, started and scored 0.0; one free agent would have flipped this one too (see the moves). Warren has still earned him 38.0 premium points, the most of any team. He holds 18 picks in the next three drafts, 10 of them in 2027. Last year's 1-6 start missed the playoffs; the model gives him a 46% chance at last place.
managers.next: Week 8: butterygoop, who has won the last four meetings. Jbird531 is at 11%.

moves.intro: No trades this week. One free-agent tight end, again, and Wallner working the wire.

items.title: Davis Allen, for nobody
items.text: Allen scored 20.0 while unrostered that week. In for Tyler Warren (0.0), he flips Jbird531's 17.74-point loss to Wallner; in for Higbee (4.4), he flips YoungBuck04's 6.46-point loss to HillBillyWorm.
items.verdict: The second straight week a free-agent tight end flipped more than one game here.

items.title: Two adds, one start
items.text: Wallner picked up Jordan Watkins and Zonovan Knight as free agents, dropping Eli Heidenreich. Watkins started right away.
items.verdict: Tyler Huntley, his best pickup of the season, came off the free-agent list the same way.

items.title: The all-in trades, three weeks on
items.text: Henry, Chase and Waddle have all started for triccster since week 5 (see his card). Jeanty has started all three weeks for brettmn13, and Quentin Johnston has 6.7 in one start for Jbird531.
items.verdict: triccster is 3-0 since. brettmn13 and Jbird531 have the picks.

trends.title: What seven weeks means here
trends.text: No team had started 7-0 before. All five 6-1 teams in league history made the playoffs, and two won the title. All nine 5-2 teams made it too; 4-3 teams made it 56% of the time and 3-4 teams 38%. None of the eight 2-5 teams did.

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 7 averaged 132.3 a team, up from 125.6 the week before.

history.title: Week 7, all time
history.text: The highest week 7 score on record is DMsourbeer's 172.0 against Wallner last year. The closest week 7 game was brettmn13 over jake188, 123.56 to 117.82, in 2022.

ahead: Game of the week: DMsourbeer and HillBillyWorm, a first meeting between two teams on either side of .500 and as close to a coin flip as the board has. Also: Colt45Johnson against triccster's four-game streak, and brettmn13 and BROCKSTARxD at exactly 50-50.

nfl.note: Headlines as ESPN reported them on the date shown. Injury and depth-chart news can change before kickoff.
nfl.intro: triccster's Giants backfield loses Tyrone Tracy to injured reserve during the Giants' bye, and his tight end Erick All is out too. Wallner may get Lamar Jackson back, and BROCKSTARxD has Baker Mayfield back.

items.headline: Giants place RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR with hamstring injury
items.note: triccster has all three Giants backs: Tracy, now on injured reserve, plus Cam Skattebo and Devin Singletary. The Giants are on bye in week 8.

items.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
Ravens' Jesse Minter optimistic QB Lamar Jackson can return vs. Bills
items.note: brettmn13 has Mark Andrews and DMsourbeer has Zay Flowers in that offense.

items.headline: Kirk Cousins to remain Raiders' starting QB vs. Jets, Klint Kubiak says
items.note: Colt45Johnson's Kirk Cousins scored 20.4 on his bench. Jbird531 has Fernando Mendoza, the backup.

items.headline: Baker Mayfield returns for Bucs, but WR Emeka Egbuka, RT Luke Goedeke out
items.note: BROCKSTARxD has both. triccster has Bucky Irving in that backfield.

items.headline: Bengals put TE Erick All Jr. on IR; believed to be torn ACL, per source
items.note: triccster's Erick All is on injured reserve.

items.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley says hamstring 'great' in return, not sweating back issue
items.note: butterygoop's Barkley had 62 yards and a touchdown on seven carries. brettmn13 has Dameon Pierce, who scored 11.8 on his bench.

items.headline: Browns activate Gabriel off IR, now have 4 QBs on roster
items.note: butterygoop has Dillon Gabriel, behind the starter Deshaun Watson, who is Jbird531's.
